## Summary

Describe the narrow change and its evidence level.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] No real Tilda identifiers, client content, secrets, PII, browser state, HAR, or raw traces
- [ ] Capability claims do not exceed the attached evidence
- [ ] Any write experiment includes snapshot, one mutation, reread, diff, restore, and restoration reread

## Evidence and safety impact

Explain what moved between implemented/tested, live observed, under investigation, planned, or rejected.
